correctness.rationale: Construction uses B of r>=2 points plus x,y, every two-valued B-map extended with x and y imitating 1 and 2, and h_x,h_y of two values. Listed five equivalences 0,rho,sigma,tau,1 are preserved. For any congruence theta, its B-restriction is equality or universal since all two-output maps are present. Equality case permits x~1 iff y~2 and nothing else, so 0 or tau; universal B case yields rho,sigma or 1. N5 has chain of three strict comparisons, impossible on fewer than four carrier points because partition lattice has chain length n-1.
